preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 10^4 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of strings n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) <= 8 for s in [input().strip() for _ in range(sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]))])
preconditions.description: Each string s_i has a length of at most 8.

preconditions.expression: all(s.islower() for s in [input().strip() for _ in range(sum(n for n in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(t)]))])
preconditions.description: Each string s_i consists of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == n for output, n in zip(outputs, ns))
postconditions.description: The length of the output binary string for each test case is equal to the number of strings n in that test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in output) for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each output binary string consists only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == '1' if any(s[i] == s[j] + s[k] for j in range(n) for k in range(n)) else output[i] == '0' for t_index, (output, n, s) in enumerate(zip(outputs, ns, strings)) for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The i-th bit of the output binary string is '1' if there exist two strings s_j and s_k such that s_i = s_j + s_k, and '0' otherwise.
